definitions.explanation: A published list of arrival and departure times for trains, buses, or other transportation.

examples.japanese: {時刻表|じこくひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{時刻表|じこくひょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The timetable is at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時刻表|じこくひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べました→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。

{時刻表|じこくひょう}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十|じゅう}{分|ぷん}→十分：09572_juppun⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}ます→来る：00254_kuru⟧。

notes:
{時刻表|じこくひょう} combines ⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧ (time) and {表|ひょう} (table/chart).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {時刻表|じこくひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to check the timetable
- {時刻表|じこくひょう}⟦{通|どお}り→どおり：09884_doori⟧: on schedule, as per timetable
- {時刻表|じこくひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: the timetable changes

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese trains are famous for running precisely on schedule, making timetables very reliable. Delays of even one minute are announced.

MODERN USAGE:
Apps like {乗換案内|のりかえあんない} (transfer guide) have largely replaced paper timetables. The term still applies to digital schedules.
